advisory_evidence: RECONSTRUCTED_PETROLEUM_PROPERTIES: shared cuts from the project's DWSIM characterisation of Tia Juana Light (Ledezma-Martinez 2019), not original HYSYS properties; 60 F standard-liquid basis assumed
ESTIMATED_HEAVY_RESIDUE: empirical critical-property extrapolation retained for flagged petroleum fractions
THERMAL_FIT: degree-five Cp fit, analytic H relative to 298.15 K; validated over 298.15..900 K
PR78_MODEL_DIFFERENCE: V3 low-omega coefficient 1.54226; reconstruction source 1.5422
METHANE_EXTENSION: ideal-gas Cp fit to the CoolProp alpha0 (Setzmann and Wagner 1991); CoolProp PR constants; methane binary interactions assumed zero, not fitted
METHANE_ASSAY: synthetic 0.5 mol% methane blend; hypothetical liquid-density metadata is unused by the molar feed and PR equations
NITROGEN_EXTENSION: initial charge is conserved inventory; nitrogen/hydrocarbon PR interactions estimated zero; no nitrogen dissolution in the separate free-water phase.

NITROGEN_CRYOGENIC: valid from its 63.151 K triple point (ideal-gas Cp held below 273.16 K, within 0.05 % of Span et al. 2000; CoolProp viscosity tables); PR78 Psat at 77.355 K +1.21 %, liquid density -0.07 % against Span et al. 2000 (F4, P3 WP4)

ESTIMATED_REGROUPING: PC08-12 mass/volume-constrained Tia Juana reconstruction; heavy Tc/Pc extrapolated; cut liquid viscosity Twu 1985 + ASTM D341, one cut-pair mixture term fitted to ECCC whole crudes
